positions.name: QuantumDBMigrationRationale
positions.frame: what justifies switching the analytics pipeline database from PostgreSQL to QuantumDB?
positions.why: src-1 and src-3 both state the same decision (Postgres → QuantumDB) — first as spoken declarative, then restated as a structured document line with explicit footing. src-2 and src-4 likewise restate the same performance/cost rationale (10x query gain, lower licensing cost) in the two registers. Read together, the four segments cohere as two paired restatements of a single decision-plus-rationale, one spoken and one written — the frame asks what grounds the switch, and the group holds both the fact of the decision and its stated justification without resolving which register is primary.
